# `/trigger-invocations` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /trigger-invocations/v1/status

`listTriggerInvocationStatusV1` — List latest invocation statuses

Gets a list of latest invocation statuses. Statuses of successful invocations are available for up to 24 hours. Statuses of failed invocations are available for up to 48 hours. This endpoint may only fetch up to 2000 invocations, and should not be treated as a representation of the full history of invocations.

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-invocation-status:manage, sp:trigger-service-invocation-status:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: triggerId: eq; subscriptionId: eq — e.g. `triggerId eq "idn:access-request-dynamic-approver"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: triggerId, subscriptionName, created, completed — e.g. `created`
- Returns 200: array of invocationstatus

### POST /trigger-invocations/v1/{id}/complete

`completeTriggerInvocationV1` — Complete trigger invocation

Completes an invocation to a REQUEST_RESPONSE type trigger.

- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the invocation to complete.
- Body (application/json): completeinvocation
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /trigger-invocations/v1/test

`startTestTriggerInvocationV1` — Start a test invocation

Initiate a test event for all subscribers of the specified event trigger. If there are no subscribers to the specified trigger in the tenant, then no test event will be sent.

- Scopes: sp:trigger-service-invocation-status:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): testinvocation
- Returns 200: array of invocation
